title: tomophyllum capillatum
intro: Tomophyllum capillatum, commonly known as the 'Wandering Jew' or 'Creeping Jenny', is a type of flowering plant in the family Polypodiaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Tomophyllum capillatum include its antimicrobial and antioxidant properties, which help to protect against infections and oxidative stress.
